# Kaelis — machine-readable project summary
# https://fuvji.github.io/kaelis/llms.txt

> Kaelis is a native Rust Minecraft launcher for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
> It opens in 311 ms to a full window, keeps a 31.9 MB idle working set, and
> uses 0.00% CPU while idle. Instances, mods, modpacks, resource packs, shaders,
> and accounts live in one immediate-mode window with no telemetry and no
> background service.

## What it does

- Installs and repairs Minecraft versions, libraries, assets, and the matching Java runtime.
- Searches all of Modrinth and CurseForge without an API key, resolves required dependencies, and verifies every download by hash.
- Manages instances as plain JSON folders, with hard-linked shared content so a second instance costs MB, not 600 MB.
- Promotes a launched JVM to realtime priority (high when the desktop refuses the privilege), opts it out of EcoQoS, and holds a 0.5 ms scheduler tick for the life of the game.
- Runs every screen headlessly: `kaelis --status --json`, `--list-instances --json`, `--play`, `--install-mod`, `--repair`, `--clean`.
- Supports offline profiles immediately and Microsoft sign-in through Xbox Live with the refresh token in the OS keychain.
